content:
isabel: quick one — noticed our Next starter (ESM) and the older CJS sample behave differently under transient failures. CJS sample coalesces embeds via a tiny util, ESM starter uses `Promise.all` and we see doubled embed calls + higher token bill during workshop.

marc: ah. are the SDK defaults different for ESM vs CJS bundles?

aditya: no runtime-specific behavior in server, but bundlers change how middleware is applied. ESM starter imports `@redwood/inference-js/esm` which lost a small dedupe middleware in a previous refactor.

sam: that would explain parity gap. Any quick mitigation for the starter?

isabel: added a tiny dedupe wrapper in the starter that maps input hash -> promise (works for single-instance dev). snippet: 
```js
const inFlight = new Map()
function dedupe(key, fn){
  if(inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key)
  const p = fn().finally(()=>inFlight.delete(key))
  inFlight.set(key,p)
  return p
}
// usage
await Promise.all(docs.map(d => dedupe(d.id, ()=>client.embeddings.create({ input: d.text }))))
```

el sa: small note: this won't protect cross-instance races (edge + background worker). For that we need deterministic idempotency headers and server-side coalescing.

aditya: I'll restore the dedupe middleware to the ESM build and add a test to ensure parity. Longer term: SDK will export `embeddings.coalesce()` that emits `x-redwood-idempotency` deterministically when key not provided.

marc: can we also standardize retry/backoff between JS and python SDKs? workshop logs show python waits with jitter while JS retries immediately after refresh and causes storms.

aditya: good catch. I'll add jittered backoff on refresh-triggered retries and a feature flag `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_BACKOFF=on`. Also publishing a migration note so sample apps can opt-in.

sam: for LangChain/LlamaIndex samples we should update connectors to pass an `idempotencyKey` and set agent/step retries=0 for indexing flows. That reduces overlap of retry layers.

isabel: I'll open PR for the starter dedupe + docs update. marc, can you review ESM build change?

marc: yes. I'll also add a small CI job that runs the starter indexer under mocked failures and asserts embed call count per-doc <=1.

ci-bot: ci/starter-parity job queued (will trigger on PR)

aditya: timeline: ESM middleware restore + SDK flag PR tomorrow; server-side dedupe ticket filed (#4403).

elsa: docs note: quickstart should show `dedupe` util and recommend `x-redwood-idempotency` for multi-instance uploads. I'll add a short troubleshooting blurb about CJS/ESM parity.

isabel: thanks — will close after green CI and a small cost-smoke check. :thumbsup:
